messages:
olivia: dropped a micro-proposal for the trace header CTAs. main question: should we treat download as a primary task or keep it in the kebab? figma: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-cta-compact
marc: from support POV, download is high frequency during triage. making it primary reduces friction.
rachel: agree but we need to be careful about narrow widths. maybe 3 primaries max: Copy, Open, Download. others go to kebab.
jess: a11y checklist: role=toolbar + aria-label on container; icon-only buttons must have aria-labels and 44x44 hit area; focus indicator visible and meets contrast.
kai: engineering notes: download runs async and returns a signed URL. we'll surface a focusable toast and keep a transient "Download ready" chip in the header for 24h. manifest.json will be included in the zip.
olivia: wording nit: prefer "Download trace" vs "Export". clearer language for non-engineers. also change "Copy ID" -> "Copy correlation ID".
marc: small UX: show an inline queued badge under the Download icon when job is in progress (small amber dot + "queued" label). avoids users wondering if click did anything.
rachel: mobile pattern: collapse to icons-only but ensure long-press reveals labels and a context menu: "Copy ID" / "Copy with link" / "Download (advanced)". long-press must also be available via keyboard menu key.
jess: screen reader flow: on start aria-live="polite": "Trace download started for <id>. A link will appear in notifications." on completion: "Trace download ready. Link in notifications." ensure live region updates are succinct.
kai: implementation Q: default copy should be raw id. "Copy with link" will include trace URL and timestamp. keep defaults minimal.
olivia: filename pattern suggestion: trace-<id>-<env>-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ>.zip so it's sorting-friendly. inside zip include manifest.json with keys: source, filters, fields, user, ts.
marc: CSV support request: make CSV an opt-in preset in advanced modal (flattened rows). default quick-download should be JSON zip for completeness and speed.
jess: modal accessibility: if we use an advanced modal it must trap focus, have aria-describedby for longer descriptions, and all controls need explicit labels. avoid opening modal on primary click by default.
notifs-bot: note: when download completes we will post a notification with title "Trace download ready" and link. notification should include expiry note (expires in 24h).
marc: copy/visual mismatch: UI truncates long ids with ellipsis. ensure copy button grabs full id and show toast "Full correlation ID copied" announced via aria-live.
oli via: small keyboard map idea: C=copy, O=open (new tab), D=download, K=toggle kebab. document these in the keyboard help overlay.
jess: color contrast: current icon hover state is 2.7:1 in prototype. must be improved to 4.5:1 or add a high-contrast focus ring. add 3px offset and system outline color for keyboard focus.
kai: dev plan: 1) quick-click primary triggers async download job (no modal). 2) advanced options live in kebab -> "Download (advanced)" opens accessible modal. 3) show persistent download chip in header + toast. estimate: CSV preset is extra work (1 sprint).
olivia: action items: olivia will update figma with Download wording, 44px targets, queued badge, and toolbar role; kai to implement async toast + persistent chip + manifest.json; jess to re-run accessibility scan after changes. I'll upload updated frames and tag for crit on Tues. :thumbsup:
